corrections.why: The solver answered 149. The scorer's recount on the machine returned nothing (answer_recomputed null), so it fell back to the initial state's answer, 137, and failed it. The B2 trajectory (traj4-minio-keep) itself uploaded four 3-byte test files (tmp/, models/, system/ and datasets/x.txt) to the models bucket while testing its gateway (runs/traj4-minio-keep/s3_proxy_replacement_with_minio_gateway/*/transcript.md, from line 3031), and no database row references them. So the answer on B2's machine is 137 + 12 = 149, which the solver found by listing the bucket. A, B and A2's recounts were 137 and their solvers answered 137.
